text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein phones Arab kings, emirs and heads of state to congratulate them on the Eid al-Fitr Moslem feast.
- King Hussein says he hopes that Jordan's parliamentary elections are held this year as scheduled; says he is satisfied with the practice of democracy in the country.

- King Hussein thanks Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu on his decision to release female Palestinian prisoners; says the move boosts the Middle East peace process and enhances confidence between the Palestinian and Israeli sides.
- King Hussein grants a piece of land to the journalists association to set up their headquarters.
